name: cell-preview-popover
title: Cell preview popover
description: Peek at the full value of a cut-off table cell: long text, a JSON blob or a URL in a scrollable monospaced popover with Copy.
docs: Use it in a table with table-fixed, or in any box with a width. kind is text, json (pretty-printed, keys in a quieter grey) or url (a link that opens a new tab; only http and https addresses become links). maxLines is how many lines the cell shows before the ellipsis. children replaces what the cell shows; the popover still shows the value. The expand mark appears only when the text is cut off. The cell is a button with aria-expanded; Escape closes the popover. The popover is never taller than the room the screen leaves: the value scrolls inside it and Copy stays in view. format.ts has fullText and cellText for the server.
